from pathlib import Path
import json,runpy
route=runpy.run_path("fixture/intent_router.py")["route"]
cases=json.loads(Path("Verification/comparable-use/boundary-cases.json").read_text())["cases"]
results=[]
for case in cases:
    actual=route(case["intent"])
    results.append({**case,"actual":actual,"passed":actual==case["expected"]})
print(json.dumps({"results":results,"passed":all(case["passed"] for case in results)},indent=2))
raise SystemExit(0 if all(case["passed"] for case in results) else 1)
